blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Maddie Madayag, one of the pioneers of Choco Mucho, welcomed a crucial win over sister team and defending champion Creamline as the race for the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals heats up. Madayag may have been limited to three points, but her leadership and timely touches contributed to Choco Mucho’s 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13 win over Creamline to stay in the semis race on Thursday night at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
